description: This file defines a custom Android UI component 'TvChannelCard', a specialized view representing a TV channel with associated info such as program title, channel info, live status, and rent badge. It is tailored for Android TV with focus animations and overscan-safe margins.

classes.name: TvChannelCard
classes.description: A custom view that displays TV channel information in a card format, optimized for Android TV with focus highlights, overlay badges, and program progress indicator.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TvChannel data object to the view, updating all displayed information accordingly.
